modalContent.challenge: A 4-star hotel in Tirana was losing bookings because guests couldn't get quick answers about availability, pricing, and amenities — especially outside business hours.
modalContent.solution: We built a multilingual WhatsApp + web chatbot that handles room inquiries, processes bookings, and sends confirmation emails — in Albanian, English, Italian, and German.
modalContent.results: The bot handles 80% of guest inquiries automatically. Direct bookings jumped 35% in the first month. Staff now focus on in-person guest experience instead of answering the same questions over and over.

modalContent.challenge: An e-commerce platform with 10,000+ products struggled with text search. Customers couldn't find products when they didn't know the exact name.
modalContent.solution: We implemented visual search powered by AI — customers snap a photo or upload an image, and the system finds matching products instantly using computer vision.
modalContent.results: Search-to-purchase conversion improved 28%. Average time to find a product dropped from 3 minutes to 15 seconds. Customer satisfaction went up 22%.

modalContent.challenge: An agricultural exporter needed to track produce from farm to destination for EU compliance. Paper records were unreliable and audits took weeks to prepare.
modalContent.solution: We built a QR-based traceability system. Each batch gets a unique code scanned at every checkpoint — farm, processing, packaging, shipping. Full chain visible in one dashboard.
modalContent.results: Audit prep time went from 2 weeks to 2 hours. Zero compliance violations since launch. The client expanded to 3 new EU markets within 6 months.

modalContent.challenge: A mid-size accounting firm processed 500+ invoices monthly by hand. Data entry errors caused payment delays and frustrated clients.
modalContent.solution: We deployed an OCR pipeline that scans invoices (PDF, photo, email), extracts key fields (amount, date, vendor, line items), and pushes data directly into their accounting software.
modalContent.results: Processing time dropped from 8 minutes to 30 seconds per invoice. Error rate fell from 12% to under 1%. The team redirected 15+ hours per week to advisory work.

modalContent.challenge: A hotel chain with 8 properties managed reviews across Google, Booking.com, TripAdvisor, and Facebook separately. No unified view, slow response times.
modalContent.solution: We built a centralized dashboard that aggregates reviews from all platforms, runs sentiment analysis, suggests AI-generated responses, and tracks trends over time.
modalContent.results: Average response time dropped from 48 hours to 4 hours. Overall rating improved from 4.1 to 4.6 stars within 3 months. Management now has real-time visibility across all properties.
